about: Sites Octo links to and never reads, in any reader or browser, because their terms or robots.txt bar AI agents or automated copying (instafy-web-research, Link-only sites). A reader that enforces this list treats it as a safety guard: it refuses the URL and every redirect hop that lands on one. Matching: "example.com" matches that host and any subdomain; "example.*" matches the label followed by one or two public-suffix labels of 2 or 3 letters (example.de, example.co.uk, www.example.com.au). Add a site when its terms bar AI agents or automated copying, with the reason; robots.txt is checked on every read anyway, so a robots-only block needs no entry.

sites.why: terms bar AI agents and deep links
